extDescription.message: Block elements on the sites you choose by .class / #id or CSS selectors; hidden automatically

hintUrl.message: Wildcards (*) are supported; otherwise the URL must contain the text

hintElement.message: Class / id must start with . (class) or # (id), e.g. .ad-banner, #popup. Full CSS selectors work too, e.g. div[data-ad] > a. One element per save

hintNote.message: Optional. Only a note to tell elements apart, it does not affect blocking. Leave it empty to add no comment

editUrlTitle.message: Click to edit the blocked elements of this URL

removeTarget.message: Remove this element from the block list

addNote.message: Add a comment to this element

editNote.message: Edit / delete the comment of this element

errUrlRequired.message: Please fill in the URL rule

errElementRequired.message: Please fill in the element to block

errMultiple.message: Only one element can be blocked at a time

errNeedPrefix.message: Start with . (class) or # (id), or use a full CSS selector

importInvalidJson.message: Import failed: not a valid JSON file

importNoRules.message: Import failed: no usable rule in the file
